scope: The upper and lower worlds, Batara Guru and Wé Nyiliq Timoq, Batara Lattuq, Tompoq Tikkaq, and birth of Sawérigading and Wé Tenriabéng. Leiden opening portion, not entire epic.
editorial_boundary: Leiden NBG-Boeg 188 and Makassar manuscript are fragmentary and separate. No full Bugis-to-English collation; original English narrative synthesis is based on identified institutional synopses and scholarship. Distinguish poem events from historical assertions. No community authorization to perform original text is claimed.
